question: 每月各商品的销售金额
gold_sql: select substr(o.order_time, 1, 7) as month, p.product_name, sum(oi.subtotal) from orders o join order_items oi on o.order_id = oi.order_id join products p on oi.product_id = p.product_id where o.status = '已完成' group by 1, 2
raw_output: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_time) AS month, product_id, SUM(subtotal) AS total_sales FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE orders.status = '已完成' GROUP BY month, product_id ORDER BY month, product_id
